message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data built into this chat, so I can’t tell you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment.  
Here are a few reliable ways to check it right now:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Visit <https://www.airnow.gov/> and enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code. |
| **AQICN** (World Air Quality Index) | Go to <https://aqicn.org/city/los-angeles/>. |
| **Weather apps** | Most weather apps (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, Apple Weather) display an AQI value for major cities. |
| **Local news** | Many local stations (e.g., KABC, KCAL) report air quality during severe pollution events. |

If you want a quick snapshot, you can also use a voice assistant (Google Assistant, Siri, Alexa) and say “What’s the air quality in Los Angeles?” They pull the latest data from the EPA or other partners.
